ai_summary: Affle 3i Limited's step-down subsidiary is acquiring Perion Network Ltd. for approximately US$ 420 million in an all-cash transaction, strategically expanding its AI-powered consumer conversion business into developed markets and omnichannel advertising channels. This move is projected to make Affle net debt-free post-acquisition, achieve an FY2028 revenue run rate over US$ 700 million, and be EPS accretive within the first year following the transaction. A notable red flag is the "go-shop" provision, allowing Perion to solicit alternative bids, which introduces a potential for increased acquisition cost or the deal falling through.
